question: Can independently configured HTTPS Base RPC sources produce registry-bound finalized native-USDC evidence for the kernel without exposing credentials or enabling writes?
startingState: Commit c69e3c0 provides a fail-closed pure evaluator over trusted prevalidated observations, but source labels, RPC identity, canonical finalized anchors, and native-USDC runtime identity are not collected or proven.
boundedChange: Add a strict hashed Base source registry, secret-resolved HTTPS JSON-RPC transport, two-source finalized-anchor collector, native-USDC proxy/implementation identity checks, receipt and authorizationState observation collection, sanitized provenance, deterministic fixtures, and adversarial tests. No wallet, signer, transaction submission, payment, deployment, or production mutation.
successCondition: Two distinct trust domains agreeing on Base chain ID, a shared finalized block, allowed native-USDC code identity, receipt facts, and authorizationState produce deterministic registry-bound observations; malformed/config-drifted/redirecting/HTTP/wrong-chain/forked/token-mismatched/timeout/oversized responses fail closed; all prior tests and containment gates pass.
failureCondition: Any caller-selected source label or URL is trusted, any secret appears in output/error/journal, any disagreement is silently quorum-accepted, any write RPC or payment path becomes reachable, or existing containment/evidence tests regress.
requiredReceipts: Passing collector and source-registry tests using independent deterministic transports
Sanitized conformance fixture and reproducible collection provenance
Independent threat-model review of SSRF, source independence, finality, native-USDC identity, and secret handling

events.note: Collector requires unanimity across sorted registry sources with distinct declared trust domains; no majority vote can suppress a contradiction.
Authoritative state and code reads are bound to one shared Base finalized block hash using EIP-1898 requireCanonical, with chain ID plus genesis checkpoint verification.
Unknown native-USDC proxy or implementation bytecode opens the circuit until the allowlist and Circle event-order assumptions are reviewed.

Live read-only conformance passed against the official Base RPC and PublicNode at one unanimous finalized anchor, including genesis, USDC proxy/implementation, metadata, and EIP-1898 authorizationState.
Frozen Session 2 gates passed: 203 tests, TypeScript typecheck, clean build, diff check, and live receipt byte parity.
events.value: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && git diff --check

events.note: Deterministic adversarial collector tests cover registry drift, endpoint mutation, private/reserved DNS, JSON-RPC envelopes, wrong chain/genesis/fork/code/state, finalized receipt disagreement, pending finality, and read-only method containment.

Independent review found mutable resolved source metadata could redirect a branded source if endpoint and expectedOrigin were changed together; objects are now frozen and transport revalidates a copied URL against immutable origin, with regression coverage.

shipped: Strict hashed Base source registry, immutable secret-resolved endpoints, and DNS/TLS-hardened read-only JSON-RPC transport.
Unanimous shared-finalized collector with Base genesis checkpoint, EIP-1898 state binding, receipt normalization, and upgrade-aware native-USDC proxy/implementation allowlist.
Operator CLI, deterministic adversarial suite, source documentation, and a sanitized live two-provider conformance receipt.
verified: 203/203 tests, typecheck, clean build, diff check, live receipt parity, and public no-spend containment pass.
Official Base RPC and PublicNode agreed at finalized block 49509847 on genesis, canonical hash, native-USDC code identity/metadata, and the sanitized authorizationState read.
Independent threat modeling and adversarial review drove genesis pinning, EIP-1898 binding, DNS controls, immutable registry snapshots, and the resolved-source mutation fix.
unproven: The two development endpoints are operator-declared failure domains, not provider-signed proofs or a production SLA; production should use contracted diverse providers or a self-validating node.
The v0.1 kernel does not yet verify the collection digest, and the source registry has no external signature, anti-rollback publication, or revocation service.
next: Build the signed operator effect-authority contract/registry and authority-bound evaluator.
Create the v0.2 wrapper that verifies Base collection and effect attestations before upgrading assurance.
Bind v0.2 inputs and bundles to durable journal heads, then add the no-action shadow runner.
